title: Modular Bookshelf
subtitle: Flat-pack wooden shelf with cam locks and dowels
description: Assemble a 3-tier modular bookshelf from flat-pack components using cam lock fasteners, wooden dowels, and hex bolts. No power tools required.

steps.title: Insert Dowels into Side Panels
steps.instruction: Press 6 wooden dowels into the pre-drilled holes on the inner face of each side panel. Each side panel has 6 holes arranged in 3 pairs.

spatial_placements.location_description: Inner face of left side panel, 3 pairs of pre-drilled holes at shelf height positions
spatial_placements.orientation: Flush with panel surface, seated fully in hole

spatial_placements.location_description: Inner face of right side panel, mirroring left panel hole positions
spatial_placements.orientation: Flush with panel surface, seated fully in hole

common_mistakes.explanation: One or more dowels are protruding from the panel surface. They must be fully pressed flush.
common_mistakes.correction_action: Press each dowel firmly until it sits flush with the panel surface. Use a rubber mallet if needed.

common_mistakes.explanation: Dowels are inserted on the outside (visible) face of the panel instead of the inner face.
common_mistakes.correction_action: Remove dowels and reinsert them on the inner face (the side with pre-drilled cam lock holes).

steps.title: Thread Cam Lock Bolts into Shelves
steps.instruction: Screw a cam lock bolt into each pre-drilled hole on the ends of all 3 shelf boards. Each shelf end has 1 bolt hole.

spatial_placements.location_description: Pre-drilled hole on each end of shelf board
spatial_placements.orientation: Bolt head flush with shelf edge, threads protruding from shelf end

orientation_constraints.rule: Bolt threads must protrude from the shelf end face, not the shelf surface

common_mistakes.explanation: The cam bolt is not screwed in deep enough. The head must sit flush with the shelf edge.
common_mistakes.correction_action: Continue screwing the bolt until the head is flush with the shelf edge surface.

steps.title: Attach Bottom Shelf to Left Side Panel
steps.instruction: Align the bottom shelf dowels with the lowest pair of holes on the left side panel. Insert the cam bolt into the cam disc hole and turn the disc clockwise to lock.

spatial_placements.location_description: Bottom position on left side panel, shelf perpendicular to panel
spatial_placements.orientation: Shelf surface facing up, cam bolt aligned with cam disc hole

orientation_constraints.rule: Arrow on cam disc points toward the cam bolt before turning. Turn clockwise 90 degrees to lock.

common_mistakes.explanation: The cam disc was turned counter-clockwise, which does not engage the bolt.
common_mistakes.correction_action: Turn the cam disc clockwise (to the right) until you feel it tighten and lock.

steps.title: Attach Middle and Top Shelves
steps.instruction: Repeat the shelf attachment process for the middle and top shelf positions on the left side panel.

spatial_placements.location_description: Middle and top positions on left side panel
spatial_placements.orientation: Shelf surfaces facing up, parallel and evenly spaced

steps.title: Attach Right Side Panel
steps.instruction: Align the right side panel dowel holes and cam disc holes with the protruding dowels and cam bolts on the right ends of all 3 shelves. Press firmly and lock all 3 cam discs.

spatial_placements.location_description: Right side, flush with all 3 shelf ends
spatial_placements.orientation: Inner face with cam disc holes facing shelves, panel vertical

common_mistakes.explanation: The right side panel is flipped. The cam disc holes should align with the shelf bolt positions.
common_mistakes.correction_action: Rotate the panel so the pre-drilled cam disc holes line up with each shelf level.

steps.title: Attach Back Panel
steps.instruction: Lay the assembled bookshelf face down. Place the HDF back panel over the rear opening and secure with 8 panel pins along the edges.

spatial_placements.location_description: Rear face of assembled bookshelf, covering full opening
spatial_placements.orientation: Smooth finished side facing outward (away from shelves)

spatial_placements.location_description: Evenly spaced along all four edges of back panel into side panels and shelves

orientation_constraints.rule: Smooth side faces outward. Rough side faces the shelves.

common_mistakes.condition: Back panel rough side facing out
common_mistakes.explanation: The back panel is placed with the rough unfinished side facing outward.
common_mistakes.correction_action: Flip the panel so the smooth laminated side faces outward.
